visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person with short black hair and a baseball jersey sits on outdoor stairs, yawning widely with eyes closed. They stand up in front of an exhibition hall entrance with large glass doors and banners. (2) Inside a bright, high-ceilinged venue, the person stands near a hairdressing station where a stylist works on a mannequin head with vibrant orange and red hair. (3) The person sits at a low table, operating a blue-lighted game controller to move a complex robotic chassis with orange balls. (4) The person stands next to a man holding a white box, reaching in to pick out a small colorful block. (5) A group shot shows the main character standing with four students wearing school vests and white shirts, all posing for the camera in a wide hallway. (6) In a workshop setting, the person holds a grey 3D printing pen, drawing yellow patterns onto a small cardboard triangle alongside another individual. (7) The character stands on a circular glowing platform that rotates rapidly, while they strike dynamic poses; visual effects like sparkles and digital overlays appear on screen. (8) The person stands before a large blue and pink backdrop with the text 'FUTURE ON', speaking directly to the camera with hand gestures, while promotional graphics cycle behind them. (9) The person bends over a table to sign notebooks for several young children in blue shirts, surrounded by a crowd in the exhibition hall.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music starts with a driving beat. A male voice speaks excitedly with an upbeat pitch contour. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect occurs. Ambient indoor chatter is audible beneath the music. (3) A mechanical whirring sound is heard as the male voice describes operating a robot. (4) A digital camera shutter sound effect triggers a new phase, accompanied by short rhythmic pulses in the BGM. (5) The male voice shifts to a faster speech rate while explaining a 3D printing activity; sounds of a faint buzzing motor are present. (6) A loud 'whoosh' transition effect coincides with a swell in the BGM volume. (7) The male voice adopts a more formal, promotional tone while speaking about exhibition dates, with the BGM rhythmically ducking slightly. (8) Sounds of a marker squeaking on paper occur alongside children's high-pitched chatter in the background. (9) The music fades out with a final synthesized chord.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Experience 1 -> Experience 2 -> Experience 3 -> Promo Summary -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional guide for 'WorldSkills Asia Taipei 2025.' By using a 'first date攻略' (first date guide) hook, the creator humanizes the large-scale technical event, showcasing interactive exhibits like 3D printing and robotics as engaging date activities to attract a younger audience and encourage attendance.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct promotion of event dates, location, and organizers; presence of official logo throughout the video.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The fast editing pace and variety-show style text overlays are typical of Taiwanese social media content aimed at high engagement and information density.
